name: documentation-standards
title_zh: 文档改动前先问一句：这行字还作数吗
tagline_zh: 仓库文档三天就过期？它盯着 README、runbook、ADR 和 API 说明，每次改动先核对现状。
tagline_en: Docs rot in days? It audits READMEs, runbooks, ADRs, and API notes—flags stale claims before you commit, so prose.
desc_en: Keep software-repository documentation accurate, lean, and task-oriented. Use when creating or restructuring repository documentation, or when changes affect user-visible behavior, operations, architecture, security boundaries, or public interfaces such as APIs and configuration. Covers READMEs, runbooks, architecture and security documents, ADRs, references, and troubleshooting guides. Skip pure
why_zh: 不是排版洁癖，是拿行为当标尺：凡用户看得见、操作会变、安全边界动了的，都强制过一遍文档。
why_en: Not a style nag—it ties docs to behavior. Any change touching UX, ops, security, or public APIs triggers a doc check, so prose.
limit_zh: 只管软件仓库的 Markdown/AsciiDoc 文档，不碰纯教程、教学博客或外部知识库；不生成新文档。
limit_en: Only repo Markdown/AsciiDoc docs—no tutorials, blogs, or external KBs. It reviews/restructures, never writes fresh. Without a git diff or change.
title_en: Ask before docs drift: is this line still true?
